sloka: तं घातं घोरसङ्काशं न स्मरन्ति दिवौकसः ।निमेषान्तरमात्रेण तादृशानां महात्मनाम् ।। ७.१०१.९ ॥
transliteration: taṁ ghātaṁ ghorasaṅkāśaṁ na smaranti divaukasaḥ ।nimeṣāntaramātreṇa tādṛśānāṁ mahātmanām ।। 7.101.9 ॥

translations.english: The gods do not even remember that terrible destruction of those great souls (Gandharvas), as it occurred within the mere twinkling of an eye.
